title: SpyGlass Pharma Celebrates Grand Opening of New Irvine Headquarters, Positioning Itself for First Product Launch and Custom R&D Space
summary: SpyGlass Pharma, a biopharmaceutical clinical-stage company dedicated to transforming treatment for patients living with chronic eye conditions, today celebrated the grand opening of its new Irvine headquarters, marking a pivotal point in the company's growth.
